They almost made us feel guilty for not bringing the kids.  Almost.

Mourners release balloons at the end of a memorial service in Amory, Miss., Friday, Sept. 12, 2014.  Police say Timothy Ray Jones Jr., 32, killed his three boys and two girls, wrapped their bodies in separate trash bags and drove around for days across several states with their decomposing bodies before dumping them on a rural hilltop in Alabama. The children were remembered at the Amory Church of Christ. A program showed a photo of each child smiling and offered a description of what they liked to do.  (AP Photo/Thomas Graning)
